errors.network: The connection was lost. Reload the page to see whether your change was saved.

unsavedChanges.title: Leave without saving?
unsavedChanges.result: The changes you made on this page will be lost.

MANAGER.title: Nothing to do yet
MANAGER.line: Requests sent back to you, your drafts, your open requests, the cash you hold, low stock and lines due soon will appear here.

HEAD.title: Nothing to decide yet
HEAD.line: Requests waiting for your approval, overspends, write-offs, product suggestions and stuck requests across all branches will appear here.

PRINCIPAL.title: Nothing to approve yet
PRINCIPAL.line: Requests waiting for your approval and your branch's requests and spending will appear here.

FINANCE.title: Nothing to approve yet
FINANCE.line: Requests waiting for your approval, requests waiting for settlement and money with managers will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.schoolNameHint: Shown in the menu and on printed requests.
settings.schoolYearStart: First day of the school year
settings.schoolYearStartHint: Until it is set, Analytics has no "This school year" period.
settings.priceHintPercentHint: A price that differs from the catalog price by more than this shows a hint.
settings.overspendGuardHint: When the actual total is above the planned total by more than this, the Procurement Head must acknowledge it before Finance can close. 0 means every overspend.
settings.reminderHoursHint: A request waiting longer than this reminds its approvers.
settings.escalationHours: Tell the Procurement Head after, hours
settings.escalationHoursHint: A request waiting longer than this is reported to the Procurement Head.

branches.title: Branches
branches.name: Name
branches.codeHint: 2 to 4 Latin capital letters, for example CHL. Used in order numbers.
branches.emptyText: Every school site is a branch, with a short code that order numbers carry.
branches.deactivateResult: The branch leaves the lists where new records are made. Its people, stock and old records stay, and you can activate it again.
branches.activateResult: The branch comes back to the lists where new records are made.

users.title: Users
users.usernameHint: 3 to 30 lower-case Latin letters, digits, _ or . (no spaces). Used to sign in.
users.roleFixed: The role is set when the account is made. For another role, make a new account.
users.headBranches: A Procurement Head works in every branch.
users.noBranches: No active branch yet. Add one under Branches first.
users.passwordHint: Type a password or generate one. There are no password rules.
users.replace: Replace {name} as Principal of this branch: they are deactivated and signed out, and waiting requests pass to the new Principal.
users.emptyText: Each person who works with orders or the warehouse gets an account with one role.
users.shownText: Give this password to the person now. It is shown only here and only until you leave this page.
users.renewText: The old password stops working at once and the person is signed out on every device.
users.renewConfirmResult: The old password stops working and {name} is signed out on every device.
users.renewOwn: You cannot renew your own password. Another Procurement Head can.
users.deactivateResult: They are signed out on every device and cannot sign in. Their records stay, and you can activate the account again.
users.activateResult: They can sign in again with their password.
users.activateReplaceResult: {other} is deactivated and signed out, and waiting requests pass to {name}.
users.lastHead: This is the only active Procurement Head, so the account cannot be deactivated.
users.ownAccount: You cannot deactivate your own account.
users.replaceResult: {name} is deactivated and signed out on every device, and waiting requests pass to the new Principal.

managerRights.title: Rights
managerRights.intro: All rights are on by default. A right switched off applies in all of this Manager's branches.
managerRights.inactive: Activate the user to change rights.

names.WRITE_OFF_COUNT: Ask for write-offs and run stock counts

off.CREATE_REQUESTS: The Manager can only view requests.
off.RECORD_PURCHASES: The Procurement Head records them, or moves the request to another Manager.
off.CANCEL_PURCHASES: Only the Procurement Head can cancel a record.
off.CLOSE_ALONE: Every request of this Manager goes to Finance for closing, even when all labels are green.
off.ISSUE_STOCK: The Manager can view stock but not give items out.
off.RETURN_REVERSE: Only the Procurement Head can do these.
off.TRANSFER_STOCK: Only the Procurement Head can send transfers.
off.WRITE_OFF_COUNT: Only the Procurement Head can start them.
off.SET_MINIMUMS: Only the Procurement Head sets them.

catalog.title: Catalogs
catalog.noResultsText: Try another word, or clear the search to see every entry.
catalog.deactivateResult: It leaves the lists people pick from. Old records keep it, and you can activate it again.
catalog.activateResult: It comes back to the lists people pick from.

fields.name: Name
fields.fromDefault: Made from the product's own entry

hints.shortName: Shown next to quantities, for example kg or pcs.
hints.allowDecimal: Tick it when a quantity can be 2.5, as for kg; leave it for pcs.
hints.taxId: Optional. 9 digits for a company, 14 for a person.
hints.responsibleName: Optional. Plain text, not an app user.
hints.branch: Chosen once: a department stays in its branch.
hints.type: Product by default. A service, such as a repair, delivery or printing, never enters the warehouse.
hints.defaultCompanyId: Optional. Suggested as the brand or company of a request line.
hints.referencePrice: Optional. Whole so'm. Later it changes as a new price with a note.
hints.referencePriceLater: Changes as a new price with a note, kept in the price history.
hints.photoFileId: Optional. JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC up to 10 MB.
hints.locked: Locked: the item is already used.
hints.subtypePrice: Optional. Whole so'm. Without one the subtype has no reference price. Later it changes as a new price with a note.
hints.subtypePhoto: Optional. Without one the product's photo is shown. JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC up to 10 MB.

measures.title: Measures
measures.description: Units of products, and whether they allow decimals.
measures.emptyText: Add the units products are counted in, such as kg, l or pcs.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Groups of products for search and reports.
categories.emptyText: Add groups such as stationery, cleaning or furniture.

extra-costs.title: Extra cost types
extra-costs.description: Costs on top of the price, such as delivery or loading.
extra-costs.emptyText: Add costs such as delivery, loading or installation.

companies.title: Companies and brands
companies.description: One list for the brands on requests and the suppliers on purchases.
companies.emptyText: Add the brands people ask for and the suppliers you buy from.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: The units of each branch that receive items, with their responsible person.
departments.emptyText: Add the units of a branch, such as the kitchen, the library or a classroom.

products.title: Products and services
products.description: Everything the school buys, with its measure, photo and reference price.
products.emptyText: Add the items the school buys, such as paper, detergent or a repair service.

catalog.oneBranch: Branch {code} · {name}, as chosen in the branch switcher on top.

subtypes.title: Subtypes
subtypes.none: No subtypes. The product is picked as it is.
subtypes.firstNote: This becomes the product's first subtype. The stock, request lines and price recorded for the product so far stay with it.
subtypes.lastActive: The last active subtype stays active. To stop using the item, deactivate the product.

prices.title: Prices
prices.emptyText: Every product and subtype of the catalog appears here with its price.
prices.newPriceHint: Whole so'm. The current price stays in the history.
prices.noteHint: Why the price changes, in a few words. Up to 200 characters.
prices.noRows: No price has been set yet.

description.departments: Add many departments of any branch from one Excel file.

templateText.products: One row per product without subtypes, or one row per subtype with the product's name repeated. Category, measure and company must already be in the catalog.
templateText.departments: One row per department. The branch is its short code, such as TSH.
